data.name: Really Real Bots (3.10.5 SAIN Preset)
data.teaser: 3.10.5 SAIN Preset designed to work well with Fontaine's Realism Mod paired with TarkovIRL.
data.description:
NOTE: I’ve moved on to SPT 3.11.3 so I no longer have the motivation to continue updating this preset for 3.10. However the developer of IRL Tarkov has made his own improved version of it. Check it out here

Thought I’d share this WIP SAIN preset I’ve been tinkering with on 3.10 with the Realism Mod. The goal is to get bots that will be challenging but fair.

Realistic Combat Overhaul by Tritantrfl7 was used as a template for this preset.

Notes:

- Best used with Realism Mod and TarkovIRL as the preset is configured with these in mind

- Tarkov Weather System and Immersive Daylight Cycle recommended for extra immersion

- Configured with That’s Lit installed

Key Differences from RCO Preset:

- Bot stats are scaled per difficulty level to allow for some randomness

- Bot aiming precision adjusted to reflect TarkovIRL handling

- Bots will struggle more to see you in poor weather conditions (goes well with TWS)

- General difficulty sliders are set to default to allow for simple difficulty tweaks

I’m open to suggestions on how to possibly improve this preset further as alot of testing is usually required to get bot configs just right.

versions.description:
THAT'S LIT Update:

Changes:

\- Increased vision distance at night to 30% of base

\- Some of the global vision speed settings have been disabled

\- Global recoil increased to 1.75

\- Bots now have a 10% chance to aim for the head

\- Global Faster CQB has been disabled again

I don't recommend grabbing this update if you don't use That's Lit. These settings have been tweaked due to allow That's Lit to handle the majority of the bot's vision speeds. To compensate for (potentially) faster vision speeds, I've increased the global recoil multipler by 0.25. These changes have not been tested yet as I haven't been playing 3.10 as much lately, but as usual, let me know in the comments if you have any feedback

Thanks to [fallenq](https://hub.sp-tarkov.com/user/64778-fallenq/) for pointing out the That's Lit specific changes

Changes:

\- Turned SAINs door handling off by default

1.0 release

Changes:

\- Bot personality types now feature varied changes to their aggression values

\- Bot hearing has been adjusted again in all areas (this is a tough one tbh. Probably still needs tweaking xD)

\- Bot vision in poor weather has been buffed slightly (was finding that PMCs were struggling to see when it was just raining)

1.0 will not mean that I will stop making more changes to this preset, just that I will stop posting releases for every single change that I make. Updates past 1.0 will be based on your suggestions/feedback rather than my personal adjustments. The main issue really is getting hearing and vision speed just right, I'm pretty happy with their shooting skills when they actually do start fighting me.

Known issues:

\- Bots sometimes get stuck on doors (This isn't something I can really fix with just the preset, consider it a free kill xD)

**Note about 3.11:**

I'm currently tinkering with presets on the SAIN test build that I will release whenever SAIN gets an official release on the hub

Changes:

\- Faster CQB Reactions are now scaled per difficulty level

\- Tbh I don't actually remember if I made other changes xD

This preset is getting very close to being considered complete for the use case I planned it for. I think I will tinker a bit with the personalities beforehand however as per a commented suggestion.

Changes:

\- Global Faster CQB Reactions has been turned on as I felt that PMCs were reacting too slow up close (I may tune this further per difficulty/bot type)

\- Slight hearing buff both generally and per difficulty

\- Base vision distance per difficulty has been increased for PMCs (they're definitely not as blind now xD)

Remember that you can use the global difficulty sliders to make all bots easier or harder if necessary and of course, all feedback is welcome.

I also recommend that you set bot difficulty for PMCs and Scavs on your chosen spawn mod to AsOnline/Random if possible to get the max benefit out of the per difficulty settings.

Changes:

\- All general difficulty sliders are now set to 1

\- Bot hearing has been buffed a bit (this may need more adjustments)

\- Scavs have received some more per difficulty stat changes

\- Bot vision at night during snow/winter has been increased (this may need more adjustments)

Changes:

\- General difficulty multipliers reset to 1 (bot hearing still at 0.6)

\- Bot vision in poor weather conditions nerfed a bit (when you see a bot snipe another one from 50+ meters in the thickest fog, you know a change is needed xD)

\- PMC gain sight coef per difficulty level was backwards so I fixed that hopefully xD

Overall, the PMC bots might be slightly more accurate but **should** struggle more to gain visual in bad weather conditions. Future updates will be done with the general difficulty set to 1 so that you can make the bots easier or harder by just changing those values
